entities.name: Syr Ellivere
aliases: Syr Ellivere of the Wild Court
entities.description: A human knight from Eldraine, born to a noble family in Ardenvale, who is at ease among animals.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane where Ellivere is a knight.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: Castle home of Ellivere's family, destroyed by the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Kenrith
entities.description: Ruled as High King when Ardenvale stood tall.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Claimed the title of High King and dubbed Ellivere a knight.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: Affliction assailing the Realm that Ellivere sought a cure for.

entities.name: The Wilds
entities.description: Region of Eldraine where peaceful critters greeted Ellivere.

events.summary: At her tenth birthday ceremony Ellivere releases a caged dove and speaks her first word, "fly".
events.quote: Only when she spoke the word " fly " to her new friend did it flutter away.

events.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion destroys Ardenvale and Ellivere wanders the Realm helping people.
events.quote: After the New Phyrexian Invasion destroyed her home at Ardenvale, Ellivere wandered the Realm

events.summary: High King Will Kenrith dubs her Syr Ellivere, the youngest knight ever.
events.quote: he dubbed her Syr Ellivere as a reward for her devotion to the people of Eldraine

events.summary: Ellivere ventures into the Wilds seeking a cure for the Wicked Slumber and is greeted by peaceful critters.
events.quote: Venture into the Wilds in search of a cure for the Wicked Slumber that assails the Realm.

relations.note: Dubbed a knight by him as a reward.
relations.quote: When Will Kenrith claimed the title of High King, he dubbed her Syr Ellivere
